title: Native boot playback and startup UI transitions
status: Reviewed static control flow. Boot skip consumption was observed live; full startup presentation and transition behavior remain experimental.

checks.label: Enter startup loop with same playback object
Native user skipping requires playback beyond 2000 ms
Normal parent destroys playback object after loop
Continue event consumed before screen transition guard

boot.name_source: Logical resource reference in original startup metadata; mapped to the reviewed boot adapter, not captured from each playback instance
boot.lifetime: Loop-local playback object. Initialization readiness must already be true; skip uses the normal loop exit, then the original parent destructor and renderer-owned release path.
boot.limits: Runtime startup may miss this one-time playback. Does not cover in-game timelines or arbitrary video resources. Shipping skipsplashscreen and skipvideos registrations have false availability predicates; their consumers do not establish usable launch options.

ui.completion_gate: GameState mask 0x402 must clear; individual flag meanings are not established
ui.title: UserInteraction state 8 uses CSS animation and transition delays; it is separate from native boot playback
ui.quick_menu_limit: Changes main-menu entrance timing; does not finish boot playback or bypass engine readiness

photosensitivity.behavior: Continue starts waiting for preferences completion and queues an audio request. It does not start preference loading. The coordinator performs asynchronous reads of preferences/data and preferences/savegame before reporting completion.
photosensitivity.repeat_risk: A Continue present on the completion tick can re-enter the waiting branch. Cross-frame persistence of the event is not established; repeated acknowledgements alone do not prove native consumption.
photosensitivity.presentation: The engine DOM has a splash class. Hiding that presentation preserves layout and loading work; it does not complete the coordinator, alter the native state machine or eliminate initialization latency.
